# CLI output contract

These reviewed examples pin CLI output schema version 1 independently of HTTP:

- `output.json`: JSONL event data preserves an unknown event/payload, Unicode,
  terminal controls as data, and an opaque cursor. Text rendering escapes controls.
- `empty-page.json`: offline launch listing is a single finite page document.
- `not-found.json`: machine errors preserve HTTP error code, message, details and
  request ID, plus CLI exit category. Only the generated request ID is normalized.

The process suite compares actual CLI output to the latter two fixtures. The
formatter test compares the former in both text and JSONL modes. Other commands
are checked for complete single JSON documents or newline-terminated frames,
launch/event/result ordering, publication positions, and accounting. Fixtures
must be reviewed when the output contract changes, never regenerated by tests.
